object_description: three-story orthogonal volume enclosing a central open-space system
design_condition: Set at the northeastern edge of the school grounds in alignment with the existing orthogonal buildings, the extension completes the complex and organizes distinct playgrounds, access areas, and a central break roof.

positive.statement: The precise urban-development completion preserves the existing context and links old and new naturally.

position.rationale: The extension is anchored at the northeastern edge aligned with the existing complex.

positive.statement: The floor-plan organization and distribution of uses are well structured.

position.rationale: Orthogonal massing and internal open-space organization are legible in plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The two-sided exposure and surrounding views provide high spatial quality in the classrooms.

position.rationale: Upper perimeter classroom zones are approximated along the well-exposed eastern and northern edges.

positive.statement: The separated stair and inner access figure support everyday school life and flexible use.

position.target: separated stair and inner access figure
position.rationale: The circulation figure is placed near the central access band, where the point cloud cannot distinguish interiors.

positive.statement: The robust cluster units have strong potential for future educational concepts or changes in use.

position.rationale: Repeated orthogonal volume and facade bands visibly support the clustered-unit reading.

positive.statement: The central break roof divides the open spaces into appropriate, easily playable areas.

position.rationale: The central roof break is approximated within the visible open-space system.

negative.statement: The central cloakroom situation on each floor is not operational and is not convincing.

position.rationale: The repeated central service location is approximated inside the building footprint.

negative.statement: The elaborate architectural expression remains too isolated from the existing school campus.

position.rationale: Isolation from campus is anchored toward the outer western facade.

negative.statement: The natural play area away from the building creates an everyday supervision problem during breaks.

position.target: natural play area away from the building
position.rationale: The remote play area is placed in the southeastern open site zone.

negative.statement: The building volume is slightly above average and its materialization has high costs.

position.rationale: Overall volume and extensive facade material are visible across all elevations.
